summary: Alaska Silver Corp. filed an 8-K announcing the closing of a C$7.6158 million (approx. US$5.48 million) PIPE financing. The company issued 13,846,910 units at C$0.55 per unit, each consisting of one common share and one warrant exercisable at C$0.75 for three years. Proceeds will fund expansion of its 2026 drilling program at the Illinois Creek Project from 6,000 to 9,000 metres, plus metallurgical, environmental, and general corporate purposes. The offering was made to accredited investors under Regulation D and Canadian securities exemptions, closing on August 14, 2026, pending TSXV final acceptance. As a capital-raising event, this is classified under Capital Returns, though the warrants add future dilution overhang.
